en.headline: All 400 Victoria Park fair stalls let for about 8.65 million
en.dek: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department said the three-day auction for the 2027 Lunar New Year fair drew about 1,320 attendances.
body: All 400 stalls at the Victoria Park Lunar New Year fair for 2027 were let by the end of a three-day public auction on Friday, the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department said.

A department spokesman said the stalls comprised 170 ordinary dry-goods pitches, 46 large dry-goods pitches, 180 wet-goods pitches and four fast-food pitches. Total takings were 8,651,552 dollars. About 1,320 attendances were recorded across the three auction days.

On the dry-goods pitches bid earlier in the auction, ordinary stalls went for between 8,540 and 64,000 dollars, with the top price about 7.5 times the reserve. Large dry-goods stalls sold for between 22,000 and 50,000 dollars.

The fair is the city's main Lunar New Year stall market in Causeway Bay. Successful bidders must keep to the licence conditions, and the department can end an agreement if those conditions are breached.

zh.headline: 維園年宵400個攤位全部租出 收入約865萬元
zh.dek: 食環署表示，2027年維園年宵市場一連三日公開競投周五結束，共吸引約1320人次進場。
body: 食物環境衞生署周五表示，維多利亞公園2027年農曆年宵市場400個攤位，已在一連三日的公開競投中全部租出。
署方發言人說，攤位包括170個普通型乾貨攤位、46個大型乾貨攤位、180個濕貨攤位及4個快餐攤位。總收入為865萬1552元。三個競投日共錄得約1320人次進場。
較早前投出的普通型乾貨攤位，成交價由8540元至6.4萬元，最高價約為底價的7.5倍。大型乾貨攤位成交價則由2.2萬元至5萬元。
維園年宵是銅鑼灣的主要農曆年宵市場。投得攤位的人士須遵守許可條件，若有違反，署方可終止協議。
